Messages.Author: Snodig
Messages.Body:
Fear of Mekhet:
>
> Put this card on a ready justicar or Inner Circle member and lock them. During this vampire's unlock phase, they burn 5 blood. If they cannot burn the blood, they are burned; otherwise, their controller moves this card to another justicar or Inner Circle member, or burns this card if there are no others.
>
Can Fear of Mekhet move to a vampire that is in torpor?
Older wording of the card seems to suggest it was not possible before Anarchs, but it changed to include "any" rather than "another", and lost the text that implied it burns if "no other ready" targets are available.

Messages.Author: inm8
Messages.Body:
As per the older wording one wasn’t able to pass it on to a justicar either until the Anarchs change as well.

Just by the text I would say that one was always able to pass it on to another IC member regardless of if it being ready or in torpor.

Current text has removed the reference to “ready” in the last part of the text but it is still there on the initial requirement for target which still lends itself to the confusion/question at hand.

Just by text the initial target has to be ready and the target that one can pass it on to just have to be in play...effectively having different requirements for finding a valid target.

A ruling not aligned with the above would be more confusing and would be good to consider a text change aligned with such ruling.

Messages.Author: Snodig
Messages.Body:
Well, it's already causing some confusion.
"any" was better than "another".

Messages.Author: lip
Messages.Body:
Card text changes generally coincide with a set being released.

Most important changes were announced in RTRs, there is a list of the RTRs  here , although it looks a bit sparse. The list I digged up while building the rulings database for KRCG is  accessible online , although I can't post it here because that's too many links for our forum engine it seems.

To check for card changes, I'd say ideally you best bet is to go over card images for each set.  VTES.pl notoriously has the largest card scans database, so you can check there.

Some changes were discussed at length on the  google group or the forum here, others were not. Sadly, I don't have a list of such discussions.
